data.rationale: User m.silva completed sign-ins from locations 5400 km apart within 41 minutes, with the second source IP 198.51.100.77 tagged as a suspicious anonymizing VPN in threat intel. This aligns with MITRE T1078 Valid Accounts and is corroborated by related alerts for unfamiliar ASN access and MFA challenges on host sso-gateway. The combination of impossible travel physics and anonymized infrastructure strongly suggests credential compromise rather than legitimate roaming.
suggested_actions: Contact user m.silva out-of-band to verify if they authorized the sign-in from IP 198.51.100.77 or the preceding location.
Review authentication logs on host sso-gateway for session tokens, device fingerprints, and post-login activity associated with IP 198.51.100.77.
Check identity provider audit logs for m.silva to identify any configuration changes, mailbox forwarding rules, or new app registrations following the suspicious sign-in.
Correlate the 'Sign-in from unfamiliar ASN' and 'MFA challenge from new device' alerts to determine if they represent the same attack chain targeting m.silva.
